correctness.rationale: Using a trace-coordinate generator matrix, every column has final coordinate 1 and distinct defining-set points give distinct columns because the trace pairing is nondegenerate; hence dual weights 1 and 2 are impossible. The complete fiber at y=-alpha^{-1} contains three affine-collinear points with nonzero dependence coefficients (1,-2,1), proving dual weight 3. The displayed ternary example independently has A_1^perp=A_2^perp=0 and A_3^perp=160 under MacWilliams transform.
